events.text: Peter the Great introduces a tax on beards in Russia.
Sam Houston is elected the first president of the Republic of Texas.
The first Labor Day parade is held in New York City.
Cassius Clay, later Muhammad Ali, wins Olympic boxing gold in Rome.
Munich massacre: Israeli Olympic team members are taken hostage.
Lynette Fromme attempts to assassinate U.S. President Gerald Ford.
NASA launches the Voyager 1 space probe.
The Gotthard Road Tunnel, then the world's longest road tunnel, opens in Switzerland.

deaths.text: Mother Teresa, Albanian-Indian nun and Nobel Peace Prize laureate
